paper_title: Revisiting Constraints on Resonant Axion-Photon Conversions from CMB Spectral Distortions
notes: This paper is a reanalysis of COBE/FIRAS data (from ~1996) using improved theoretical treatment of photon-to-axion conversions. While the theoretical modeling is advanced, this does not constitute a new experimental measurement. The paper explicitly states it 're-analyzes constraints' from existing COBE/FIRAS observations rather than presenting constraints from new measurements or previously unreleased data. The work updates the understanding of resonant conversion physics in the early universe but derives bounds from pre-existing experimental data.
